derivation: Registry M1..M5. machine_status has rows only for M1 and M2, both with at least one DOWN day, so the semi join keeps M1 and M2. shift_output covers M1..M4, so the anti join on output keeps M5. Inspections name M1, M2, M3 and one NULL machine; machines never inspected are M4 and M5 by NOT EXISTS and by LEFT ANTI JOIN, but NOT IN returns no rows because the NULL in the subquery makes every NOT IN test unknown. Inner join cardinality: machines joined to DOWN status rows gives M1 6 rows + M2 2 rows = 8 rows, whereas the semi join gives 2.
